answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 700 aliases means 700 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit. The epoch seed changes, so yesterday's solutions cannot be replayed. The pearl test is the live device, the summit test is the locked stake, and the violet test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
